recommendation: Implement harm reduction and medication support for substance use disorders
implementation_steps: Provide medication education about substance use disorder treatments
Support harm reduction through naloxone distribution and education
Facilitate medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) access
Collaborate with prescribers for medication induction and maintenance
Monitor adherence and manage potential drug interactions
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led harm reduction and medication support interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in opioid overdose prevention, treatment access, and medication adherence for patients with substance use disorders.
